name: Blackmaw Hold

entrance.note: Catalog entrance is unpublished (dungeons.json entrance: null; README: Alcaz and Blackmaw entrances still not published). Unofficial web reports a furbolg tunnel in northern Azshara (Warcraft Tavern 38.7, 33.4; ConquestCapped 38.4, 32.6) with a Meeting Stone nearby; the instance portal is at the far end of that tunnel (ConquestCapped Azshara 35.0, 23.4; Warcraft Tavern also lists Winterspring 66.6, 84.4). Do not treat those pins as Questie-verified Forever data. Horde access: Azshara; fly Valormok and ride northeast. All Forever quests stay verified: false until checked in game.

travel.how: Fly to Valormok in western Azshara and ride northeast toward the northern mountains / old Timbermaw gate; do not send Horde to Talrendis Point.

quests.name: Beneath Nordrassil
quests.notes: Horde breadcrumb for Get to the Roots of It. QuestieDB v1.1.3: req 45, next 92343, XP 560. Already appears on the 40-60 Azshara pack. Alliance copy 92345 is not in the Horde+neutral import (README). No dungeon-pack step; pick up in Valormok when the route is already there, then turn in on Elder Rise only if Thunder Bluff is already on the path.

quests.name: Get to the Roots of It
quests.notes: 10 Nordrassil Root Caps inside the dungeon. Giver hub is Elder Rise, Thunder Bluff — same continent as Azshara but a capital detour from Valormok. Planner should drop unless the route already visits Thunder Bluff after 92346. QDB pre.single is [92345, 92346] (any one); Horde uses 92346. Catalog minLevel 45 / questLevel 55. XP not in QuestieDB (use 0); unofficial web 11300.

quests.name: Blackmaw Magic
quests.notes: Recover a Blackmaw Ritual Totem. Giver is Muln Earthfury in northwest Mulgore (Skywatcher Plateau), not Bloodhoof or Thunder Bluff. Catalog minLevel 52 / questLevel 59. Drop unless the 40-60 route already passes that plateau. XP not in QuestieDB (use 0); unofficial web 16100.

quests.name: The Twin Bears
quests.notes: Totem of Ursoc and Totem of Ursol inside. Giver/turn-in at Ursolan in Azshara (same zone as the dungeon). Neutral races (races 0). Catalog questLevel 55, minLevel null. XP not in QuestieDB (use 0); unofficial web 11300 and Timbermaw Neutral.

quests.name: Blackmaw Reclamation
quests.notes: Varrox Bleakhoof's Head to Gatekeeper Rageroar at Ursolan. Catalog turnIn is null and README lists 92065 as no-finisher/accept-only; QuestieDB v1.1.3 has end npc 236573 and steps-v2 has turnin:92065 (placed before the run step). Record the exact step ids; planner should still turn in after the run. Neutral races. Catalog questLevel 60, minLevel null. XP not in QuestieDB (use 0); unofficial web 13200.

quests.name: Blackmaw Pouches
quests.notes: 5 Blackmaw Pouches for Ekkal at the Ruins of Eldarath. Same-zone Azshara pickup. Neutral races. Catalog questLevel 60, minLevel null. XP not in QuestieDB (use 0); unofficial web 13200.

quests.name: The Reliquary of Tyr
quests.notes: Recover the Reliquary of Tyr from Blackmaw Hold. QuestieDB sort PALADIN (classes 2), Horde races, req 50 / level 58. Giver is in Tirisfal Glades — Eastern Kingdoms, a cross-continent detour from Azshara. Planner should drop for non-Paladins and for any route that is not already in Tirisfal. XP not in QuestieDB (use 0).

keys: No instance key in the catalog. Horde breadcrumb 92346 Beneath Nordrassil (Jediga, Valormok) unlocks 92343; Alliance 92345 is not in the Horde import.
Web guides also mention Timbermaw Neutral for the Ursolan pair (92066/92065); that reputation gate is not in QuestieDB or dungeons.json.

prep.group: 5-player, dungeon levels 55-60; do not enter before 58 (runAt).
warnings: Catalog givers are split: Thunder Bluff (92343), Mulgore Skywatcher Plateau (97198), Azshara Ursolan (92066, 92065), Azshara Ruins of Eldarath (97327), Tirisfal Paladin (99187). Record each hub honestly; drop TB/Mulgore/Tirisfal pickups rather than adding detours.
92346 is already on the 40-60 Azshara route; do not add a second accept.
Entrance coordinates are unpublished in-repo; do not invent a pin for the expander.
Do not add web-only quests (Claws That Rend, A Lost Memento, Feeding Time) — they are not in dungeons.json or the Horde QuestieDB match list.
classQuests: 99187 The Reliquary of Tyr (Paladin, Tirisfal Knight of Mourning)

speedrunReplaceCandidates.why: Late Azshara outdoor loops on horde-40-60 sit under the 55-60 dungeon band; Blackmaw at 58 can replace leftover Valormok kill quests if the player is still in Azshara.
If Blackmaw is run at 58 while the 50-60 pack is in the Plaguelands, the Bulwark cauldron shuttle is the slow outdoor XP in the same band (do not drop 5098; that is the Scholomance key chain).

Web (ConquestCapped / Warcraftmaps) lists extra quests not in dungeons.json or the Horde QuestieDB match: Claws That Rend Tusks that Gore (Ogtinc), A Lost Memento (item start), Feeding Time (repeatable). Not added.
Forever dungeon-quest XP is absent from QuestieDB; unofficial web XP noted on each quest and not stored as xp.
All Forever quests remain verified: false until checked in game.
notes: Forever-only five-player dungeon in Azshara, levels 55-60, runAt 58, placement inline (fits min+3 before 60). Pickup hubs are honestly split across Thunder Bluff, northwest Mulgore, Azshara (Ursolan and Eldarath), and a Paladin giver in Tirisfal. Azshara quests are the only ones the planner should treat as on-path for a Valormok run. Dungeons-off replacement is not written in the catalog (Forever dungeon); use remaining Azshara / Plaguelands outdoor quests. XP amounts are 0 unless QuestieDB had a figure (only 92346 has 560).
